policy.reason: All 16 drawings were separately inspected at the feet. Each has a visible lower supporting foot; no unmistakable airborne frame is present. There is no drawn ground line, so y registration is an explicit visual interpretation. X uses the nominal column center and never follows a lifted leg or body width. Y removes atlas row packing drift while retaining bent-leg body-height changes. Source masks, common canvas and 1:1 pixels remain unchanged. Do not apply to another source hash.

registration.warning: This outline midpoint is a motion proxy, not anatomical head center. Side turns and source drawing-position differences remain, rather than being normalized away.

scaleRecommendation.reason: Standing running naturally has longer visible head-to-ground extent than seated dumbbell poses. Matching the old face exactly collides with classic date/time; use one lower fixed scale for all frames, with this explicit face-size compromise.

layoutSafety.method: Numerical RGBA alpha>=128 bounds against previously measured DOM typography rectangles; not a new browser or Apple-device playback test.
layoutSafety.limits: Faint alpha<128 source noise is preserved and is not used as anatomical core. Native usable viewport is smaller than the physical screen; 416px figures are full-stage comparisons, not a claim about measured Watch display size.
